fixed.summary: Each on-demand engine module (physics, story, nav, motion, destruction, video) carries the read-only data only its functions read, including motion's shader text, instead of every game downloading it in the primary: a game's first download is about 24 KB (brotli) smaller, and a module is that much larger when the game loads it. modules.json lists each module's `data` bytes. Nothing a game calls changes.
